text:
mina: Heads-up from the periodic access-scan: found ~145 admin-like grants with missing owner and >90d no-use. summary: https://internal/reports/access/scan-4250 :mag:
audit-bot: scan-result: ownerless_admins=145 stale_threshold_days=90 risk_score=0.44
raj: can you paste a quick sample?
mina: sample rows:
```
grant_id: g-0x9a7b, principal: svc-payments-batcher, role: infra-admin, last_used: 2025-11-02
grant_id: g-0x9a7c, principal: alice@oldcorp.com, role: org-admin, last_used: null
grant_id: g-0x9a7d, principal: kms-rotation-hook, role: kms-admin, last_used: 2026-01-09
```
leah: biggest risk is KMS bindings and long-running batch jobs. auto-remediations must exclude any grant that has a live cron in the service catalog.
raj: propose phased plan: 1) tag all ownerless grants with tag: "sec:ownerless-2026-03" 2) create a read-only quarantine view so ops can monitor 3) kick off owner-claim emails to potential owners 4) for svc accounts with last_used>180d, insert a temporary policy that disables token minting.
mina: agree to plan with caveat: do NOT touch kms-admin bindings until we have key policy ownership mapped.
ops-bot: action created: ACT-2026-881 entitlement-quarantine-populate assigned_to=leah due=2026-03-25
leah: I'll run the allowlist cross-check: CLI to get live cron usage:
```bash
svcctl list-crons --filter principal=svc-* --format json | jq '.[] | {principal, cron_next_run}'
```
raj: owner-claim flow mockup (email template) will be in the playbook. default TTL for claim = 7d, after which we rotate creds for svc accounts and downgrade role to least-priv template.
mina: rotation for svc creds should include a smoke test harness. plan: create rotated service-account + run 3 smoke jobs, validate metrics (success_rate > 99%). rollback if failed.
leah: KMS checklist: map key-id -> project-owner -> oncall rotation contact. Michael from platform suggested we need manual ops approval for any key-policy edits. I'll add manual approval step.
raj: SQL I used to enumerate suspects (shareable):
```sql
SELECT id, principal, role, owner, last_used FROM grants
WHERE owner IS NULL AND role ILIKE '%admin%'
ORDER BY last_used NULLS FIRST;
```
mina: logging: add structured field remediation.actor and remediation.ticket to grant-change events so we can trace who performed the remediation. ops-bot can attach ticket link.
ops-bot: note: audit-sink policy updated to include field remediation_ticket for write events.
leah: candidate canary plan: pick 12 grants across infra/human/kms buckets (but KMS only monitoring, no changes). For 8 svc accounts: tag -> restrict token mint -> monitor 48h. For human accounts: start owner-claim emails.
raj: timeline suggestion: canary kickoff 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC, monitor 48h, step to full sweep after signoff in 5 days.
mina: communication play: send targeted notif to owning teams (if available) + org-wide FYI for infra teams. templates in doc: https://internal/docs/sec/ownerless-playbook/v2
leah: I'll open a PR against ops-runbooks with the exact steps + rollback snippet for cron rebinds. snippet:
```bash
entctl quarantine --grant g-0x9a7b --reason "ownerless-90d-scan" --tag "sec:ownerless-2026-03" --dry-run
```
mina: set oncall alert rule: pager if any job error-rate > 5% or if smoke-tests fail. ops-bot: please create temporary dashboard for canary metrics.
ops-bot: dashboard created: DB-4250-ownerless-canary metrics linked in incident.
mina: final: assign owners for next steps: leah -> canary execution and allowlist, raj -> playbook & comms, mina -> incident lead + audit artifacts. tagging: @leah @raj :white_check_mark:
leah: starting list prep now. will post the 12-grant canary manifest in this thread before EOD. :hourglass:
